name: The Driver Takeshiba
source:
Lady Hinode's life is in danger, as her rivals send elite international assassins to take her life. But in their path stands he, the silent protector, known only as the driver, Takeshiba.

[From [url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/thedrivertakeshiba]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日之出女士的生命处于危险之中，她的对手派出精英国际刺客来夺取她的生命。但在他们的道路上却站着他，这位沉默的保护者，人们只知道他是司机竹芝。

[来自[url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/thedrivertakeshiba]itch.io[/url]]
